alsoLinked: Other records linked to this person
applyAnyTime: Decisions are applied within minutes, at any time of day. Sync pauses briefly while that happens. A table is applied once every conflict in it is decided.
applyFailed: Applying failed; tried again in the next window
applyWindowExplainer: Decisions are applied between {{window}} UTC. Sync pauses briefly while that happens. A table is applied once every conflict in it is decided.
askForConflictPrivilege: Ask ICT for the Resolve Sync Conflicts privilege.
askForMflPrivilege: Ask ICT for the View MFL Sync privilege.
askForPrivilege: Ask ICT for the View Sync Status privilege.
askForReviewPrivilege: Ask ICT for the Review Identity Matches privilege.
centralMissing: Central no longer has this record
centralMissingBody: It was removed here outside sync. Deciding lets the facility send it again.
centralOnly: The national sync view is shown at central, not at a facility.
centralRedoneAtFacility: Central's change is right; the facility will make it too
centralRedoneLong: Central's change is right. The facility will make the same change, and until it does the facility's version is shown here.
conflictAppliedBody: The receiver applied the decision on {{table}} {{identifier}}. The facility's held updates reach central within a few minutes.
conflictGone: This conflict has been applied already
conflictsCentralOnly: Conflicts are reviewed at central, where facility records are received.
conflictsExplainer: A facility's update to a record was held back because the record was changed here, outside sync. Compare the two versions with the facility's clinical owner and record which one is right.
conflictsNotAvailableHere: Sync conflicts are not available on this server
conflictsNotPermitted: You do not have permission to review sync conflicts
connectionFailed: Could not connect to the MFL
credentialsAreSecret: The MFL account and password are a deployment secret that ICT sets on the server. They are never shown or entered here.
decidedPending: Decided; applied in the next window
decisionFailed: The decision was not recorded. Try again.
decisionStale: This conflict changed while you were reviewing it. Reload the page and review it again.
dryRunExplainer: A dry run changes nothing. These are the changes a sync would make.
dryRunStarted: Dry run started. It changes nothing; open it below when it finishes to see what a sync would do.
effectApart: They stay apart, and are not offered for review again.
effectLink: The two records are linked to one person. Neither record is changed.
effectSeparate: The record from {{facility}} is separated from this person. Any other records linked to the person stay linked.
explainer: How facilities are sending records to the national server, and what is waiting here.
facilityStandsLong: The facility's version is right. Central's change is replaced.
identityReasonHelper: What you checked and with whom, for example the facility's records officer. Do not write the patient's name or identifiers.
identityReviewExplainer: Records from different facilities that may be the same person, which the matcher could not decide by itself. Compare the two records and say whether they are the same person. Records are linked, never merged: a decision can be reversed by a later review.
itemsUnreadable: This run's changes cannot be read
linkedExplainer: These records are linked to one person now.
mflExplainer: Copies the Ministry of Health's Master Facility List into this EMR as counties, districts and facilities, so they can be chosen as locations. The MFL owns their names, places and types; wards and departments stay local.
mflNotPermitted: You do not have permission to view the MFL sync
mflNotReadable: The MFL sync cannot be read on this server
mflNotReadableBody: The EMR did not answer. Reload the page, or ask ICT to check the server.
mflUnavailable: The MFL sync is not set up on this server
mflUnavailableBody: No MFL account is configured, so nothing can be fetched. ICT sets the account as a deployment secret; settings saved here take effect once it is.
mflUrlHelper: The DHIS2 instance root, starting https:// and without /api. Only hosts the deployment allows can be used; ICT sets that list on the server, not here.
monitoringUnreachableBody: Sync may still be healthy. The numbers below are unavailable until monitoring answers again.
name: Name
nextAfterFailure: Applying it failed at {{time}}. The receiver tries again in the next window.
nextAfterOthers: It is applied once the {{count}} other conflict(s) in {{table}} are decided too, because the whole table is applied at once.
nextByHand: ICT applies it by hand on this server.
nextInWindow: The receiver applies it between {{window}} UTC. This page updates when it has.
nextSoon: The receiver applies it within a few minutes. This page updates when it has.
noApplyWindow: Decisions are not applied automatically on this server. ICT applies them by hand.
noDifferences: No field differs in value. Show all fields to see the record.
noItems: Nothing to show: every location was unchanged.
noRuns: The MFL has not been synced yet.
notAvailableHere: Sync status is not available on this server
notPermitted: You do not have permission to see sync status
nowApart: The two records are kept as different people.
nowLinked: The two records are now linked to one person.
openMflSync: Master Facility List sync: facilities held here and their last update
queueUnreadable: The conflict queue cannot be read
queueUnreadableBody: The EMR's database account cannot read the receiver's schema yet. ICT grants it once, as the deployment runbook describes.
reasonHelper: Who you agreed this with and why. Do not write a patient's name or identifier.
recordVoided: One of these records was voided or removed at its facility
recordVoidedBody: Check with the facility before deciding.
reviewFailed: The decision was not recorded. Try again.
reviewsCentralOnly: Possible matches are reviewed at central, where records from every facility meet.
reviewsNotAvailableHere: Identity review is not available on this server
reviewsNotPermitted: You do not have permission to review possible matches
reviewStale: Someone else decided this review while you were looking at it. Reload the page.
runCounts: {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{retired}} retired, {{unretired}} restored, {{unchanged}} unchanged, {{failed}} failed, {{warnings}} with warnings
runInProgress: A run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
runNotStarted: The run was not started. Try again.
runsUnreadable: The run history cannot be read
scheduleOff: Off: runs only when started here
settingsChangedOnServer: These settings were changed on the server while you were editing: {{fields}}.
settingsChangedOnServerBody: Saving replaces them with the values shown here. Settings you did not edit already show the newer values.
settingsNotSaved: The settings were not saved. Try again.
syncStarted: Sync started. This page updates as it runs.
testFailed: The connection test could not be run.
tryAgainLater: The server did not answer. Try again shortly.
urlInvalid: Use an https:// address without a user name or password, and not ending in /api.
urlRefused: The MFL address was not accepted, so nothing was saved.
urlRefusedBy: {{reason}}. The allowed hosts are set by the deployment, not on this page: ask ICT to add the host if it is right.
waitingOnOthers: Decided; waiting for {{count}} other conflict(s) in {{table}}
